responsibility: This definition module declares Logitech-compatible fixed-buffer number-to-string conversion procedures for GNU Modula-2. It exposes routines that format CARDINAL values in octal, hexadecimal, or decimal and signed INTEGER, LONGINT, and SHORTINT values in decimal into caller-supplied character arrays, emphasizing right-justified legacy formatting rather than stream I/O.
same_name_distinction: This is the definition interface for Conversions, listing the fixed-buffer formatting procedures only; the companion Conversions.mod performs the actual string creation and copy-out work.
